description:
Ahoy, buddy! Get ready for an exciting adventure! Board your pirate ship to explore mysterious islands and find hidden treasures. But beware! Dangerous torpedoes from enemy submarines and rival pirates are out to sink your ship.

You are the captain trying to find your way to new islands. Customize your ship, navigate the deep waters, and face all the challenges of the pirate life. Use your skills to stay alive as long as possible and collect trophies for your skills.

Check out the new fun game from the NOSTRA.GAMES team. 

Are you ready to become the most feared pirate on the high seas?
name: Skull Pirates: Adventures
intro: Captain, set sail and explore the rough and tumble seas!
